pages.title: Project Overview
pages.content:
# Project Overview

This is a sample wiki generated by CodeWiki Local Agent. It demonstrates the wiki viewer capabilities.

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Copilot Agent] -->|generates| B[wiki-data.json]
    B -->|loaded by| C[Next.js Frontend]
    C --> D[Wiki Viewer]
    C --> E[Mermaid Diagrams]
    C --> F[Code Highlighting]
```

## Features

- Tree navigation with sections
- Markdown rendering with GFM support
- Mermaid diagram rendering with fullscreen zoom
- Syntax-highlighted code blocks
- Dark/light mode
- Export to Markdown or JSON

## Getting Started

Generate a wiki for your project using the `@codewiki` agent in VS Code Copilot Chat.

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

pages.title: Frontend Components
pages.content:
# Frontend Components

<details>
<summary>Source files analyzed</summary>

- `src/components/Markdown.tsx`
- `src/components/Mermaid.tsx`
- `src/components/WikiTreeView.tsx`
- `src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx`
- `src/app/page.tsx`
</details>

## Component Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Page[page.tsx] --> WikiTreeView
    Page --> Markdown
    Page --> ThemeToggle
    Markdown --> Mermaid
    Markdown --> SyntaxHighlighter
```

## Markdown Renderer

The `Markdown.tsx` component uses `react-markdown` with GFM support and custom styling. It handles:

- **Code blocks** with Prism syntax highlighting
- **Mermaid diagrams** detected via ` ```mermaid ` code fences
- **Tables** with responsive overflow
- **Links** opening in new tabs

## Wiki Tree View

Hierarchical navigation component supporting:
- Expandable sections
- Importance indicators (purple = high, beige = medium, coral = low)
- Flat list fallback when no sections defined

## Example Code

```typescript
const Markdown: React.FC<MarkdownProps> = ({ content }) => {
  return (
    <ReactMarkdown
      remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
      rehypePlugins={[rehypeRaw]}
    >
      {content}
    </ReactMarkdown>
  );
};
```

pages.title: Deployment Guide
pages.content:
# Deployment Guide

## Local Development

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:3000.

## Production Build

```bash
npm run build
npm start
```

## Docker

```bash
docker compose up
```

## Azure Web App

Deploy using the build script:

```powershell
.\scripts\Build-WikiSite.ps1 -Deploy -ResourceGroup myRG -AppName my-codewiki
```

## Deployment Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Dev as Developer
    participant Agent as Copilot Agent
    participant Build as Build Script
    participant Azure as Azure Web App
    
    Dev->>Agent: @codewiki /generate-wiki
    Agent->>Agent: Scan codebase
    Agent->>Agent: Generate wiki JSON
    Agent-->>Dev: output/wiki-data.json
    Dev->>Build: Build-WikiSite.ps1 -Deploy
    Build->>Build: Validate JSON
    Build->>Build: npm run build
    Build->>Azure: az webapp deploy
    Azure-->>Dev: Wiki live!
```
